title: feat: hide mobile sidebar with swipe gesture

issue.title: TASK-8f42 feat: hide mobile sidebar with swipe gesture

description:
## Goal
Improve mobile map usability by allowing the route sidebar/bottom sheet to be hidden with a swipe gesture.

## Requirements
- Support a natural vertical swipe gesture on the mobile sidebar/bottom sheet to dismiss it.
- Swipe down should collapse/hide the bottom sheet when the gesture passes a sensible threshold.
- Keep the existing tap/button toggle working.
- Allow the sheet to be revealed again with the existing control.
- Do not interfere with scrolling and interacting with controls inside the sidebar.
- Keep desktop behavior unchanged.
- Respect reduced-motion preferences where applicable.

## Acceptance criteria
- On mobile, a downward swipe on the sheet hides/collapses it.
- Short/accidental drags do not unexpectedly close the sheet.
- Content inside the sheet remains scrollable and interactive.
- The map becomes fully usable after the sheet is hidden.
- Existing open/close control and keyboard accessibility continue to work.
- No regression in route creation, editing, or point dragging.

## Definition of done
- Implementation follows existing UI/component conventions.
- Relevant tests are added/updated.
- Existing test suite passes.
- Desktop and mobile behavior are verified.
